evidence: OUTCOME-030, RESEARCH-401, CONTRACT-401, TASK-410, TASK-411, RISK-420, and GATE-490 are all verified with passing audits.

Normalized privileged fixture events establish exact create, grow, and rename only with complete process/file identity, size measurement, timing, operation, path, and gap-free linkage; PID/start ancestry can link one authenticated task.
Denied, pending, unavailable, not-entitled, crashed, overloaded, dropped, and gapped privileged states retain the standard snapshot/FSEvents path and never claim exact attribution.

The final gate relaunches the actual menu-bar executable and MCP connector, repeats live snapshot, status board, settings, watched/excluded monitoring, integrity-manifested export, provenance query, and stopped-service recovery journeys.

Privacy property tests, exclusion controls, bounded retention/history/queues, 100,000-event overload accounting, safe uninstall recovery, and fail-closed release preflight pass without adding deletion or telemetry.

Fixture exactness is explicitly separated from unavailable Apple entitlement and signed-host evidence. Signing, notarization, live activation lifecycle, and signed-artifact resource measurements remain visible release gates.
